title: Pagewing configuration
description: Preferences for the Pagewing PDF reader. Missing fields use built-in defaults. Restart the reader after editing.

appearance.description: Interface and page appearance at startup.

thumbnails.description: Use page previews in the sidebar.

text_embolden.description: Display-only weight for filled outline text, from 0 (original) to 1 (strong). Try 0.2 for thin serif fonts. Does not affect images, ordinary vector paths, or Type 3 glyphs. Restart to apply.

white.description: White PDF palette. Each source RGB channel is mapped between foreground (black) and background (white).

foreground.description: Output color for black PDF pixels.

background.description: Output color for white PDF pixels (paper).

canvas.description: Color outside the paper; omitted values follow the interface theme.

inverted.description: Inverted PDF palette. Each source RGB channel is mapped between foreground (black) and background (white).

foreground.description: Output color for black PDF pixels.

background.description: Output color for white PDF pixels (paper).

canvas.description: Color outside the paper; omitted values follow the interface theme.

display.description: Default reading view. Saved document views take precedence when remember_documents is true.

layout.description: Page layout: single page, continuous scrolling, or facing pages. Capitalized names are accepted for compatibility.

fit.description: Fit the whole page, width, or height, or set a zoom factor (1.5 = 150%).

remember_documents.description: Restore saved document views. If false, open at page 1 using these display defaults.

shortcuts.description: Override all bindings for an action. An empty array disables it; omitted actions inherit defaults. Conflicts and reserved keys are checked by the reader. Use key names with optional Cmd, Ctrl, Alt, Shift modifiers joined by + (for example X, Shift+J, Cmd+Comma). Cmd means Command on macOS and Ctrl on Linux.
